title: Interview Flashcards
selection_rationale: High candidate pain, likely to stop the scroll.
Concrete enough to feel immediately useful.
Creates an open loop that earns the next few seconds.

heygen_settings.captions: burned-in for TikTok/Reels, sidecar optional for archive

spoken_script: Stop memorising interview answers. Build proof cards instead. Turn common interview questions into proof cards instead of memorised speeches. First: For tell me about yourself: role, proof, direction. Second: For why us: product, people, mission. Third: For a challenge: situation, action, result, lesson. The rule is simple: Prepare flexible proof blocks for tell me about yourself, why us, and a challenge. Find the internship you are preparing for at internwise.co.uk

production_notes: Open with direct eye contact and no intro logo.
Keep cuts every 2-4 seconds using zooms, captions, or B-roll cards.
Use the first on-screen text line as the thumbnail/title frame.
Do not say 'link in bio' in the video. Put it only in IG/TikTok captions if needed.
No em dashes in captions or overlays.
